actions.action: Water, wait 30 minutes, then slide plant out to check roots
If root-bound, repot into a pot 2 inches wider with drainage and fresh mix
Water when top 2 inches of soil feel dry
If rotten, cut off mushy roots with sterilized scissors and replant in fresh mix
Cut bare, shriveled vines back to about 12 inches
Take 4-6 inch cuttings and root them in a jar of water
Plant rooted cuttings back into the pot

reason: The answer blames root-binding (with rot as an alternative) rather than overgrowth, so the diagnosis is only partial, but it still recommends repotting plus a hard trim and propagation, which matches the fix that worked, and nothing in it is harmful.
